owner_review.decision: Exact implementation-file exception preserves arbitrary caller-owned style/styleOverrides. Other rules remain active.
Keep measured dimensions and portal placement working. Review classes/CSS custom-property migration against actual dimensions and interactions; no global property allowance.
Review the styling-library interface separately. A renderer style/theme dictionary must not be stripped or blindly replaced with a classes-only object.
Preserve the track-color contrast contract while reviewing whether the stroke can be expressed through a class/custom property.
Review ownership of the injected stylesheet before moving it; this stage records a warning rather than changing its behavior.
